worldcombat.skill.ominouswind.summary: Send a ground-hugging spectral gust that only gathers on the way and bursts at the target's feet: it coils the foes there inward and deals special damage; the returning chill may temporarily raise the user's five combat stats by one stage. Haunting form is narrower and heavier with a tighter pull; roaming form is faster and wider.
worldcombat.skill.ominouswind.use.0: Aim at a distant foe and let the gust chase it down
worldcombat.skill.ominouswind.use.1: Drag a foe toward the centre, away from cover or its allies
worldcombat.skill.ominouswind.use.2: Attack during the temporary five-stat surge
worldcombat.skill.ominouswind.descriptio: The gust runs from the caster toward the chosen target: when it coils on arrival, every enemy caught takes about %1$s special damage once; it picks its target within %2$s blocks.

Along the way it only gathers and hurts no one, closing at %1$s blocks/tick and steering to follow the target; on arrival it bursts in a %2$s-block radius and pulls each caught enemy up to %3$s blocks toward the centre (less if blocked). If the target vanishes mid-flight, the gust coils at the original aim point and may find nothing.

As long as it catches at least one enemy, the user has a %1$s chance to raise their own Attack, Defence, Special Attack, Special Defence and Speed by %2$s for %3$s; a repeat trigger refreshes the timer and keeps a single layer.

Haunting form on: about ×1.1 squall power, ×0.82 coil radius, a stronger inward pull and +0.05 surge chance, but slower travel and a longer wind-up and cooldown. Off (roaming form, default): faster travel and about ×1.15 coil radius, but a lighter single hit and a weaker pull.
worldcombat.skill.ominouswind.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.ominouswind.growth.0: From level %1$s the power rises to %2$s and the travel to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.ominouswind.preference: On: coil radius ×0.82, power ×1.1, a stronger pull and +0.05 surge chance, but slower travel and a longer wind-up and cooldown - for dragging a foe out of cover or away from its allies. Off (roaming form, default): faster travel and ×1.15 coil radius, but a lighter hit and a weaker pull.
Beyond this distance the companion closes in first; larger values send the gust at more distant targets.
On: fast-moving targets rank higher, since the gust steers a little and a runner is least likely to shake it off. Off: every target ranks the same.
world_combat.move.ominouswind.text.miss: The gust coils on empty air
